base: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one front-facing standing game sprite to be split later into head and complete body. Input image 1 is the exact character identity reference, input image 2 is the ACCEPTED STYLE reference. Draw ONLY the character from image 1, retaining its recognizable hair, hat, skin tone and clothes, in the clean compact pixel-art style and proportions of image 2. Transparent background, NO floor shadow, no text, no other objects, no vehicles. One whole character. Large rounded chibi head ~52-55% of total height INCLUDING hat/hair, squat body ~28%, very short legs boots ~20%. Wide compact silhouette. Virtually NO visible neck. Head rests into collar. Head width ~1.3x body width; do not make thin elongated mannequin. Pose perfectly front-facing, both arms relaxed down, empty hands, feet together. Equal-size simple dark vertical rectangular eyes, aligned at exactly the same level; no white sclera, no anime eyelashes, no tiny detailed face. Hair may be asymmetrical like reference. Face itself centered over neck. Broad chunky pixel clusters, three flat shades per material, warm dark outline, upper-left light, about16 colors. Each apparent pixel a large uniform square; NO antialiasing/gradients/blur. Preserve identity over decorative details. Keep hair braids and beard as parts of head, resting outside shoulders if needed. Clothing visible below face should be self-contained with a simple collar/neck. Collar must not grow into face. Leave generous transparent margins.
